upstream_ordering.note: iso_chain is ordered nearest->source (transformer, then isolating devices, then circuit breaker)

damage_to_circuit.evidence_nature: HISTORICAL damage assessment (file arcos_prod_damage_09_28) — NOT a live/confirmed current outage.

units.INSTALL_HOURS: direct crew-hours to install one construction unit (CU)
units.REMOVE_HOURS: direct crew-hours to remove one CU

caveats: Apply the ILM once to summed DIRECT hours. Do NOT separately add travel/setup/safety — the ILM already accounts for them (avoids double counting).
'Labor only work' adders are DIRECT-hour adders (e.g. Restricted Access 0.5 h) and are added to direct hours BEFORE applying the ILM.
Values are averages across construction units; individual jobs vary. Treat as planning estimates.
Excavation adders are per cubic foot and require a volume not present in the storm data.

indirect_labor_multiplier.covers: drive time, safety discussion time, set up time (per workbook note)
indirect_labor_multiplier.note: The ILM should be mutiplied time any labor hours to take into account drive time, safety discussion time, set up time, etc.
